ruleDefinitions.name: Moriya Rootkit - System
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of Moriya rootkit as described in the securelist's Operation TunnelSnake report Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND ServiceName = "ZzNetSvc")
